info.name: Amazon CodeGuru Profiler Get Findings Report Account Summary

params.name: dailyReportsOnly
params.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to only return reports from daily profiles. If set to True, only analysis data from daily profiles is returned. If set to False, analysis data is returned from smaller time windows (for example, one hour).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of results returned by GetFindingsReportAccountSummary in paginated output. When this parameter is used, GetFindingsReportAccountSummary only returns maxResults results in a single page along with a nextToken response element. The remaining results of the initial request can be seen by sending another GetFindingsReportAccountSummary request with the returned nextToken value.

params.name: nextToken
params.description:
The nextToken value returned from a previous paginated GetFindingsReportAccountSummary request where maxResults was used and the results exceeded the value of that parameter. Pagination continues from the end of the previous results that returned the nextToken value.

This token should be treated as an opaque identifier that is only used to retrieve the next items in a list and not for other programmatic purposes.

items.docs: Returns a list of FindingsReportSummary objects that contain analysis results for all profiling groups in your AWS account.

params.name: endTime
params.description: The start time of the profile to get analysis data about. You must specify startTime and endTime. This is specified using the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2020-06-01T13:15:02.001Z represents 1 millisecond past June 1, 2020 1:15:02 PM UTC.

params.name: locale
params.description:
The language used to provide analysis. Specify using a string that is one of the following BCP 47 language codes.

  • de-DE - German, Germany

  • en-GB - English, United Kingdom

  • en-US - English, United States

  • es-ES - Spanish, Spain

  • fr-FR - French, France

  • it-IT - Italian, Italy

  • ja-JP - Japanese, Japan

  • ko-KR - Korean, Republic of Korea

  • pt-BR - Portugese, Brazil

  • zh-CN - Chinese, China

  • zh-TW - Chinese, Taiwan

params.name: profilingGroupName
params.description: The name of the profiling group to get analysis data about.

params.name: startTime
params.description: The end time of the profile to get analysis data about. You must specify startTime and endTime. This is specified using the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2020-06-01T13:15:02.001Z represents 1 millisecond past June 1, 2020 1:15:02 PM UTC.

items.docs: Returns a list of Recommendation objects that contain recommendations for a profiling group for a given time period. A list of Anomaly objects that contains details about anomalies detected in the profiling group for the same time period is also returned.
